claim_text: under verbatim queries with 20% character noise character n-gram BM25 (MRR = 0.4703) significantly outperforms word BM25 (0.3694 pHolm = 0.0011) and dense models (0.1345)
notes: Confirmed on synthetic character noise; however on clean OCR and real degraded OCR word BM25 outperforms character n-grams (0.832 vs 0.731 clean 0.668 vs 0.591 degraded). Scope qualification required.

claim_text: Under natural light paraphrasing however word BM25 collapses by 76% (MRR = 0.0875) where hybrid dense-sparse fusion and clean visual streams take over (p < 0.01)
notes: Scaled 100k permutation tests confirm Hybrid (0.1110) and Hybrid+CLIP (0.1249) significantly outperform collapsed BM25 (0.0875, pHolm < 0.002). The 0.125 text figure is traced to Hybrid+CLIP (0.1249) and must be labeled explicitly.

claim_text: Dense proxy collapse is driven by a discrete tokenization bottleneck: character corruption induces a +122% explosion in WordPiece subword fragmentation (1.347 to 2.994 subwords/word) and catastrophic embedding drift (cosine similarity drops to 0.4655 at 20% noise) causing dense bi-encoders to fail completely on numeric identifiers (MRR = 0.033) and short entities (0.068)
notes: Empirically confirmed: only 0.64% of receipts exceed 512 tokens (mean tokens lost 0.032%). Chunked MaxP retrieval does not close the gap with BM25 (MiniLM: 0.2030 vs 0.2056, BGE: 0.3028 vs 0.3022). Dense failure is genuinely driven by representation drift and subword fragmentation on structured alphanumeric layout.

claim_text: second-stage cross-encoder cascades (BGE-reranker) provide the largest performance lift (+0.0522 clean +0.0460 noise MRR p = 0.0011)
notes: Gains confirmed across clean and noisy regimes. Note p=0.0011 reflects permutation floor at 10000 iterations; Phase 1.5 will re-evaluate with >=100000 permutations.

claim_text: heuristic reliability weighting fails (MRR drops to 0.3574 vs. 0.3694 p < 0.01) with observable reliability AUROC inverting from 0.9948 on synthetic noise to 0.2674 on optical degradation
notes: Confirmed across 4 Apple Vision configurations: AUROC remains inverted (~0.23) under both languageCorrection=True (0.2322) and False (0.2304). Language correction does not explain the inversion; vocabulary OOV fundamentally cannot detect optical blur.

claim_text: On 2754 pooled queries across 200 random splits distribution-free conformal cascade calibration guarantees non-escalated miss rates <= 0.05 (empirical 0.0579 UCB 0.0529) at an 89.5% escalation rate reducing latency by 10% vs. Always-Escalate while increasing MRR (0.3527 vs. 0.3485)
notes: Empirical test miss is 0.0579 and coverage is 36.5%-37.0% across 200 splits. Conformal cascade does NOT guarantee miss rate <= 0.05. At equal escalation rate (89.5%), a simple fixed margin threshold (tau=0.380) matches MRR (0.3526). Retract strict guarantee claim; frame as empirical cascade calibration.

claim_text: 8: "On N=1000 MS-COCO Karpathy-test images native visual retrieval (CLIP ViT-B/32 MRR = 0.4709 Hit@10 = 0.7570) decisively outperforms machine caption proxies (MiniLM MRR = 0.3728 Hit@10 = 0.6530; all pHolm = 0.00040)"
notes: Native visual superiority confirmed across Hit@1, Hit@5, Hit@10, and MRR with 100k permutations (CLIP diff +0.0981 MRR, pHolm = 8e-5; SigLIP Base Patch16 diff +0.2343 MRR, pHolm = 8e-5).

claim_text: 9: "Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) confirm Grounded Extractive Bridging is statistically equivalent to Generative LLM Bridging (0.640 vs. 0.640 TargetHit@10 p_TOST = 0.00000 inside Delta = +-0.05) without generative API costs"
notes: Fabricated TOST on copied arrays replaced with exact paired discordant analysis: Proposed MM-RAG beat Hybrid on only 2 queries and lost on 1 (net diff +1/50, exact McNemar p=1.000); matches Single-Stage Dense (32/50, p=1.000). Multi-hop LLM bridging adds no statistically detectable retrieval value over single-stage retrieval.

claim_text: 10: "Clean OCR character error rate CER = 0.4519 and word error rate WER = 0.6503; Realistic optical degradation CER = 0.5218 and WER = 0.7561"
notes: Legacy CER/WER severely inflated by SROIE comma truncation and unnormalized reading-order transposition. Corrected normalized line-aligned metrics: Clean CER = 0.1387, WER = 0.2165; Degraded CER = 0.3086, WER = 0.4595. Explains high clean BM25 retrieval.

claim_text: 11: "H2 confirmed: learned query router beats All-Stream RRF (+0.1938 MRR)"
notes: Reconciled with Sec IV-I. Learned router adds only +0.0071 MRR over Tuned Hybrid under 20% noise and <=0 on real OCR. Claim of +0.1938 was an artifact of comparing against unnormalized All-Stream RRF (0.1827). H2 is KILLED.

claim_text: 12: "Ablation of Multimodal Clean-Stream Fusion: combining pure BM25 with clean vision achieves a statistically significant improvement over baseline hybrid under 20% proxy noise (0.9450 vs. 0.8254 MRR pHolm = 0.0012)"
notes: Stale legacy claim from 55-probe private split (Table VII). On public test split (Table tab:ablation_v2) BM25+Clean is 0.369 vs Hybrid 0.369 (no difference).

claim_text: 13: "conformal cascade (tau_conf = 0.135) guarantees non-escalated candidate miss rate is bounded by <= 0.05 with an empirical escalation rate of only 14.55%"
notes: Stale legacy claim from 55-probe private split. On public benchmark tau=0.384 and escalation rate is 89.5%.

notes: Stale legacy numbers from 55-probe private split. On public test split clean MiniLM is 0.210 and 20% noise is 0.068.

claim_text: 17: "Deterministic extractive bridging matches generative LLM bridging on multi-hop Target Hit@10 (0.640 vs 0.640)"
notes: Direct artifact of np.copy in TOST script. True paired empirical analysis shows Proposed MM-RAG (0.640) matches Single-Stage Dense (0.640) and has no significant difference from Hybrid (0.620, exact McNemar p=1.000).

claim_text: 18: "Heavy paraphrase retrieval performance (MRR ~ 0.009) reflects proxy failure under heavy lexical drift"
notes: Legacy heavy paraphrase MRR of 0.0089 matched uniform random chance (0.00895) due to aggressive token stripping. Redesigned answerable question queries establish valid benchmark: BM25 MRR = 0.8878, MiniLM = 0.2873, BGE = 0.5191.

claim_text: 19: "Headline Decision Rule: In text-proxy multimodal retrieval
location: query mismatch is a far more catastrophic failure mode than proxy OCR corruption"
column6: Empirically and statistically confirmed: Query mismatch drop (0.3782 [0.3315, 0.4273]) significantly exceeds clean Apple Vision OCR degradation (0.0201 [-0.0041, 0.0441], diff +0.3581, p=1e-5) and degraded optical blur degradation (0.1600 [0.1216, 0.2019], diff +0.2182, p=1e-5) with completely non-overlapping 95% CIs.
